item.title: Airman rescue shows US can penetrate enemy territory 'anywhere' in Iran, former Pentagon official warns
item.summary: Retired Navy captain and former Pentagon official Brent Sadler says the daring rescue of a downed U.S. airman in Iran sends a powerful warning to Tehran's leadership.

item.title: Warnock likens pro-Trump Christian leaders to those who used Scripture to defend slavery
item.summary: Sen. Warnock compares Christian leaders backing Trump to those who justified slavery, saying their faith-based support for the president is misguided.

item.title: Ex-CIA station chief reveals how agency exploited Iranian communication channels during airman rescue
item.summary: Former CIA station chief Dan Hoffman says the agency tracked Iranian forces and ran a deception operation to help rescue a downed U.S. airman.

item.title: Neal Schon and bandmate Jonathan Cain battle lawsuits and politics as Journey's farewell tour rolls on
item.summary: Journey bandmates Neal Schon and Jonathan Cain are feuding over politics, religion and lawsuits even as their farewell world tour moves forward.

item.title: Retired F-16 pilot says rescued US airman's survival in Iran highlights intense evasion training
item.summary: A U.S. airman survived days in enemy territory before being rescued, highlighting the high-stakes training fighter pilots undergo.

item.title: White House faith advisor says Americans are leaving organized religion but not losing faith in God
item.summary: Paula White-Cain delivers an Easter message of hope and redemption while pushing back on data showing declining religious affiliation in the U.S.

item.title: Reese Witherspoon’s daughter lands surprise role with Miranda Lambert in Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ video
item.summary: Ava Phillippe follows in her famous parents' footsteps with a starring role in country star Ella Langley's hit "Choosin' Texas" music video release.

item.title: Pair of Democrat lawmakers slam 'blockade of fuel' to Cuba, 'economic bombing' after visit to island
item.summary: Reps. Pramila Jayapal and Jonathan Jackson said after a Congressional delegation to Cuba that U.S. economic restrictions on the island represented an "illegal U.S. blockade of fuel."

item.title: New Hampshire suspect who shot officer and triggered massive manhunt killed in police gunfight
item.summary: Suspect who allegedly shot a New Hampshire police officer is killed in a gunfight after a massive manhunt that included a shelter-in-place order.

item.title: Baby among 3 dead in holiday horror as Easter egg hunt turns deadly
item.summary: Three people were killed after high winds knocked down a tree onto a group of people in Germany during an Easter egg hunt on Sunday morning, police said.
